bundle.shortDescription: Unified game and app library for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Meteor gathers the games you own on Steam, Epic, GOG, EA, Ubisoft, Xbox/Game Pass and Battle.net, plus your Windows apps, into one library — with cover art, playtime tracking and an in-game metrics overlay.
